publicationType: Derived public evidence summary; not a replayable raw bundle or an independent human study.
laterChanges: The publisher qualifies later copy/documentation changes separately. They do not retroactively change the original predictor or native-report build identities.

fixedDetectionAxes.automaticCoverage: 10 × automatically accepted original endpoints / predeclared original endpoint opportunities. Acceptance is not correctness; missing or not-run endpoints remain in the denominator. Cohorts stay separate.
fixedDetectionAxes.referenceCompatibleAutomaticCoverage: N/A without frozen observations of the same physical event and verified lane. Do not use bracket centers as exact electronic labels.
fixedDetectionAxes.primaryCandidateLocalization: Use only the predeclared top-ranked same-event candidate and frozen envelope. Unaccepted proposals are not automatic success; absent matching references yield N/A.
fixedDetectionAxes.knownInvalidGuards: Report only specifically frozen cases, with denominators. Unknown clips are not known negatives; no population false-acceptance rate is estimated.
fixedDetectionAxes.terminalLatency: clamp(5 + 5 × log2(fixed baseline median / candidate median), 0, 10). This is a first-terminal proxy; skipped Finish work is not equivalent-work throughput.

cycles.summary: Freeze the six-phone development baseline before changes: 5 of 12 automatic endpoints.
One-attempt robustness baseline: 11 of 12 condition endpoints; dark Finish requires review.
Unsafe regression: a moving shoe becomes an automatic Start. Raw acceptance rises to 6 of 12 but is not a correctness gain.
Reject dense Finish parity: no new real candidates in 36 configurations and three new High flat-cut proposals.
Reject both registered quantization variants; no runtime or evaluation release.
Reject the demonstrated shoe proposal through before-state verification. Acceptance returns to 5 of 12; broader hardware identity remains unresolved.
Withhold Finish across incompatible athlete regions. Preserve shared Start; six-phone acceptance falls to 4 of 12 and condition coverage to 6 of 12.
Actual explicit-left selection produces timing and movement/COM results; changing athlete invalidates them without changing the recording or attempt.
Fresh default first-test batch accepts 0 of 4 endpoints; guided development batch also accepts 0 of 4. Both Start results require review and neither Finish runs.
Direct native Start-frame setup and keyboard selection pass on the real development recording. Reviewed Finish now leads to saving; no post-test detector tuning.

currentFixedRubricScores.meaning: Evaluator judgment on its frozen ten-cycle rubric, not a measured percentage of timing correctness.

separateIndependentClosingReview.source: Independent final_experience agent; rubric and initial grades frozen before reading the cycle ratings.
separateIndependentClosingReview.remainingBlockingFinding: None reported after the reproduced manual-Finish next-action issue was corrected.
separateIndependentClosingReview.meaning: A different rubric, reported separately without averaging. Evidence strength 4.5 is not estimated 45% accuracy.

sixPrivatePhones.meaning: Existing development recordings. Session, athlete disjointness and stationary capture suitability are not certified; six files do not mean six independent people.

robustness.conditionsMeaning: Original, native null reencode, 640/426 long side, and brightness minus/plus 0.12; copied audio, no crop, retime or official-time hints.

clockScope.strictWholeContainerV1: Failed before predictions: final AAC packet duration changes from 143 to 142 samples at 44.1 kHz.
clockScope.prospectiveInteriorV2: All 724 video PTS, AAC packet DTS/PTS/payloads and decoded PCM hashes match. The one-sample final duration delta lies outside the comparison interval. Whole-container equivalence is not claimed.

freshPublic.meaning: Predeclared clip/source-group first test, not proof of named-athlete disjointness from all historical material. Later races cannot replace the first primary.
freshPublic.currentStatus: Entire group is development after the original default results.

referenceFreeze.independenceLimit: Separate prediction-blind AI observations; broad unannotated extraction windows were shared. Not recruited human reviewers.

freshPublic.reason: Start observations are unresolved and Finish is not run; no matching apparent-pad output exists. No physical-event substitution or displayed-total arithmetic.

latencyQualification.meaning: Single passes, not repeated throughput gains. Cycle3 also contains an invalid accepted terminal state. No headline performance or accuracy score is inferred.

cycle8.invalidationPreserves: Shared Start, original native source, input hash, session and lineage.
cycle8.browserVersion: Not explicitly recorded in this individual artifact.

cycle10.keyboardPath: Tab, type four percentage edges, Enter to Apply.

nativeIntentResolution.meaning: Legacy source clocks are operational anchors. Scripted durations are not human correction times, event error or independent accuracy; cycle8 retains the populated movement/COM proof.

verificationOn8102b51.generatedDualLaneFixture: Original CC0 geometry/audio for workflow, cancellation and invalid-input controls only; no field accuracy credit.

failureHistory: Original baseline already rejected IMG9075 automatic Start. Cycle3 introduced the shoe acceptance and cycle6 removed it; this is not new recall or precision over baseline on that case.
IMG9199 Start shifts from 7.121 to 7.068 while Finish remains 17.472. Its bottom-edge floor/diffuse cue identity is unverified.
Dense Finish parity gains no real candidates and produces three new High flat-cut proposals; both quantization variants fail registered criteria and are not released.
Cycle8 preserves the failed CSP blob-fetch and hidden-control harness reports. The successful native run changes neither production CSP nor app behavior to bypass them.
An independent cycle10 review reproduces a manual-Finish next-action bug before the UI-only 8102b51 correction. The failed proof and successful regression remain referenced.
RGB-only entering-object hardware identity and four quantization cases remain five explicit expected failures. No perfect general rejection claim.
limits: No recruited independent human study, exact sensor-trigger accuracy or calibrated camera/audio delay.
No population false-acceptance rate, human correction-time benefit, training-decision benefit, voluntary return or actual iPhone field validation.
Public availability is not redistribution permission. Downloaded media remains outside Git.
No absolute local paths, signed media URLs, private pixel/landmark arrays or PCM payloads are published here.
This derivative supplies artifact hashes and selected observations, not a replayable raw evidence bundle.
